# stalwart_spam_training_sample (Data Source)

Stores an email sample used for spam classifier training.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Identifier of the account associated with this training sample
- `blob_id` (String) Reference to the stored message content
- `delete_after_use` (Boolean) Indicates whether the training sample should be deleted after being used for training
- `expires_at` (String) Timestamp when the training sample is scheduled to expire
- `from` (String) Email address of the sender of the message associated with this training sample
- `is_spam` (Boolean) Indicates whether the sample is spam (true) or ham (false)
- `subject` (String) Subject of the message associated with this training sample
